info.title: Bantaba API
info.description: REST API shared by the web app and the organizer/staff mobile apps. Amounts are integer minor units (butut, GMD). Sign in with POST /api/v1/auth/login, then send the access token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. See docs/api.md.

ticketIds.description: Tickets to refund; omit for all of your valid tickets in the order

includeFee.description: Admin only: also return the booking fee

note.description: Shown to the customer. Required when rejecting.

reference.description: Reference of the money sent back (bank transfer / Wave payout)

email.description: Who gets the ticket. They accept by signing in (or signing up) with this address.

token.description: The token from the emailed link (the part after #token=)

OrganizerVerificationStatus.description: APPROVED lets them publish; SUSPENDED stops all their ticket sales at once.

customLimits.description: true: use maxTicketsPerEvent / maxTicketPrice below instead of the level's limits

maxTicketPrice.description: With customLimits, minor units; null = no limit

verifiedBadge.description: Verified badge (blue tick) shown next to their name: for official organizers whose identity the platform has confirmed. Needs an approved account.

payoutAdvancePercent.description: Share (0-100) of an upcoming event's earnings they may be paid before it happens. 0 = only after the event (docs/payouts.md).

payoutAutoApprove.description: Their payout requests are approved automatically (an admin still sends the money). Checks on the balance, hold period and verified payout details still apply.

payoutAutoApproveMax.description: With payoutAutoApprove: largest payout (minor units) approved automatically; bigger ones wait for an admin. null = no limit.

note.description: Required when sending back: what the organizer should change

whatsapp.description: A phone number (7 digits for Gambian numbers, or international) or a wa.me link

bio.description: "About": shown on your public profile. Up to 1,000 characters.

contactEmail.description: Public contact email (can differ from your sign-in email)

RefundPolicy.description: When ticket holders may ask for a refund. Default NONE.

refundDaysBefore.description: With UNTIL_DAYS_BEFORE: refunds close this many days before the start (0–365).

transfersEnabled.description: Whether ticket holders may send their tickets to someone else. Default true.

refundDaysBefore.description: With UNTIL_DAYS_BEFORE: refunds close this many days before the start (0–365).

transfersEnabled.description: Whether ticket holders may send their tickets to someone else. Default true.

CancellationRefundMode.description: AUTOMATIC (default): every ticket holder is refunded in full, booking fee included. ORGANIZER: you handle it; ticket holders may request a refund at any time.

requestId.description: The change request's id, from GET /admin/events/changes

updatedAt.description: The request's updatedAt as you saw it: if the organizer edited it since, the decision is refused

requestId.description: The change request's id, from GET /admin/events/changes

updatedAt.description: The request's updatedAt as you saw it: if the organizer edited it since, the decision is refused

accountName.description: Name on the Wave account or bank account

accountNumber.description: Wave: the phone number (7 digits, +220 optional). Bank: the account number.

password.description: Your current password: changing where money goes needs it, so someone who gets into a signed-in browser can't redirect your payouts

updatedAt.description: payoutAccount.updatedAt as you saw it: if the organizer changed the details since, the verification is refused

note.description: Required when rejecting: shown to the organizer

reference.description: Reference of the Wave payment or bank transfer

status.description: "ok", or "degraded" when the database can't be reached.

accessToken.description: Short-lived JWT (15 min by default). Send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

refreshToken.description: Opaque, single-use. Exchange at POST /auth/refresh; store it in the Keychain/Keystore on mobile.
Replaces the refresh token you sent, which is now revoked. Reusing the old one signs the user out everywhere.

reference.description: Reference of the refund made in the Modem Pay dashboard

included.description: true = the booking fee is inside this event's ticket prices.

amount.description: Minor units: per order, per ticket, or the flat part of "pct". At most D500.

cap.description: Minor units: at most this per ticket ("pct" only). Null = no cap.

endsAt.description: When the deal ends (then the usual fee applies). Null or missing = no end.

keepFee.description: true = keep the booking fee when a buyer asks for a refund.

TicketStatus.description: Status before this scan (a VALID scan has just set it to USED).

event.description: The ticket's own event — differs from the scanning event on WRONG_EVENT.

gate.description: Gate the scan was recorded at (the staff member's assigned gate if they didn't name one).

ticket.description: Null when the code isn't a ticket at all (INVALID).

expectedGates.description: Phase 19: the ticket's own gates; empty when it can use any gate. On WRONG_GATE, send them to the first.

atOtherGate.description: Let in at a gate that isn't theirs (by a manager, or because the event lets everyone in).

override.description: A manager let them in at the wrong gate.

gatesOpenAt.description: On WRONG_DATE before the gates open: when they open.

wrongGate.description: "send" = send them to their gate (a manager can let them in); "allow" = let in, tell them their gate.

gatesOpenAt.description: When the gates open (ISO time); null for the usual window before the start.

gateIds.description: The gates this standing ticket type enters through; empty = any gate.

id.description: The phone's id for this scan: sending it twice is harmless.

h.description: sha256 (hex) of the QR code: the same hash the ticket list uses.

at.description: When it was scanned, by the phone's clock.

letIn.description: The phone let them in (a VALID, or a manager's "Let in here").

deviceId.description: A random id the phone makes once and keeps.

since.description: serverTime from the last sync; missing = send the whole ticket list.

pending.description: Scans still waiting on the phone after this send (for the organizer's list).

seatIds.description: The seats to block or unblock. Leave out for every seat in the section (a reserved section).

frontLabel.description: What the seats face, shown above every seat grid: "Stage", "Pitch"…

rows.description: Rows A to Z (26), or up to 60 with "seats".

numbering.description: "letters" (the default): each row from 1, A1–A30, B1–B20. "running": the numbers run on through the section, A1–A30, B31–B50. "seats": one number per seat, no row letters, 1–144.

firstRow.description: The first row's letter, when rows don't start at A ("D" for rows D–G). Ignored with "seats".

removed.description: Places with no seat, as "row-place" counted from 1: ["1-12", "2-12"] for an aisle.

gateId.description: The gate its ticket holders go in by. null = none; leave out to keep it.

ticketTypeId.description: The ticket type the section is sold as; null = not on sale.

closedSeatIds.description: Every seat in the section that is closed for this event (cameras, sound desk). Leave out to keep them.

details.description: Description, poster, rules, contacts, refund and transfer settings. Default true.

ticketTypes.description: Ticket types and prices. Default true.

seating.description: What each section is sold as and the closed seats (needs ticketTypes). Default true.

currentPassword.description: Needed when changing a password that's already set.

accessZone.description: Zone this gate admits into; null = open gate.

serves.description: Phase 19: the sections and standing ticket types that enter here.

role.description: The staff member's StaffRole, or "ORGANIZER" for an organizer at their own event.

assignedGate.description: If set, every scan by this person happens at this gate.

wrongGate.description: Phase 19: "send" (send them to their gate) or "allow" (let in, tell them their gate).

gatesOpenAt.description: When the gates open, if the organizer set it.

canLetInAnyGate.description: May tap "Let in here" at the wrong gate (managers and the organizer).

expectedGate.description: Phase 19: their own gate, when scanned at another.

override.description: A manager let them in at the wrong gate.

offline.description: Phase 21: scanned without signal and sent later.

letIn.description: Phase 21: for offline scans, whether the phone let them in.

myRecentScans.description: The caller's own last 15 scans at this event, newest first.

apiVersion.description: API version this server speaks; the apps call /api/v{apiVersion}/...

minSupportedVersion.description: Oldest app version still allowed. An app below this should block and ask the user to update.

latestVersion.description: Newest released version. An app below this (but above the minimum) may suggest updating.

until.description: Shown until (YYYY-MM-DD = the end of that day). Default and latest: the end of the event.
Shown until (YYYY-MM-DD = the end of that day); never later than the end of the event

ids.description: Every current pick's id, first to last

onePerHost.description: At most one event per host across the row
